findings.detail: Algorithms for registration, login, 2FA, Argon2id hashing, PBKDF2 key derivation and Zod validation are described (§2.11).
Password protection, encryption, validation, rate limiting and prompt-injection defences described; verified against code (argon2, AES-256-GCM, Zod).
A public REST API with keys is mentioned (§2.12) but not documented.
No OpenAPI/Swagger spec or reference.
Endpoints not enumerated: code exposes 14 route handlers (incl. SSE /api/ai/chat, Stripe webhook, /api/export/*, ICS feed, WS token) and 231 tRPC procedures.
No performance measurements; the live evals in the repo have p50/p95 latency (10.3 s / 52 s routing run; 6.6-7.9 s / 20-24 s persona run) that could be reported.
Optimisations described: SQL aggregation, context packets, rolling summary, deterministic detection.
No caching mechanism described beyond Redis for rate limits; provider prompt caching (system prompt kept byte-identical, see src/server/llm/prompts/pageContext.ts) is implemented but undocumented.
Most figures are followed by explanatory text.
Appendix 5 lists nine screenshot captions (/dashboard ... /orgs) but contains no images: the screenshots are missing.

Unit tests described, but the count is stale: document says 141 test files; the repo now has 163 (148 unit, 12 integration, 3 live-eval).
Integration tests against a real Postgres described; matches CI job 'Integration tests (Postgres)' in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
Component/UI tests with React Testing Library described; no browser e2e exists and none is claimed.

§2.14.5 and Appendix 4 report only the offline run and state that live mode was not measured. The repo contains a live routing eval (2026-09-25, gpt-oss-20b): routing 72.7% (40/55), schema validity 96.4% first pass / 98.2% after repair, tool selection 76.5%, p50 10.3 s; and a persona eval (2026-10-17, 'Деси', 44 turns): 2 of 9 criteria fully pass, routing about 94%, failures on Latin-script Bulgarian, invented entities and event time zones.
